name: [MULTIPLE CARRY] 🗻 Mount Sibuatan
desc:
Welcome to Mount Sibuatan, a mountain located in North Sumatra, Indonesia, standing tall at over 2,457 meters above sea level. Explore the lush tropical forest, feel the cool mountain air, and roleplay your way through an immersive climbing journey!

💡 Pantun time!

Mendaki gunung di pagi hari,
Angin sejuk datang perlahan.
Serunya naik Sibuatan ini,
Ajak teman biar lebih aman!
